param: Λ Recruitment/birth inflow into child susceptible population (S_C).
μ Natural death rate (applies to all human compartments). Text: ~1/(72*52) per week.
ξ_M Rate at which susceptible children enroll into monitored vaccination program (S_C → M_C^V).
ξ_U Rate at which susceptible children enroll into un-monitored vaccination program (S_C → U_C^V). Estimated by fitting.
ψ Maturation/aging rate from children (<15) to adults (≥15). Text: ψ (denoted j in text) ≈ 1/(15*52) per week.
β_C Effective transmission/contact rate for children (child susceptibility/infection force). Estimated by fitting.
β_A Effective transmission/contact rate for adults (assumed lower than children). Estimated by fitting.
ξ_A Adult catch-up vaccination enrollment rate (S_A → V_A). Text: taken as 0 during Nepal data period.
ε Residual susceptibility factor for un-monitored vaccinated individuals; (1-ε) corresponds to vaccine effectiveness in text. Text: measles vaccine effectiveness ~77–86%.
η_U Immunization rate for un-monitored vaccinated children (U_C^V → I_mC). Estimated by fitting (text uses h_U).
η_M Immunization rate for monitored vaccinated children (M_C^V → I_mC). Estimated by fitting (text uses h_M).
η_A Immunization rate for vaccinated adults (U_A^V and V_A → I_mA). Text: taken as 0 during Nepal data period (h_A=0).
δ Progression rate from exposed to infectious (incubation). Text: incubation ~10 days ⇒ δ ≈ 0.7 per week.
γ Recovery rate from infectious. Text: recovery ~15 days ⇒ γ ≈ 1/2 per week.
d Disease-induced death rate in infectious compartments (I_C, I_A). Text references CFR; symbol d used in equations.
